With 218 deluxe rooms and suites overlooking the scenic Giang Vo Lake. The centrally-located hotel is the perfect place for your Hanoi stay, whether for business or pleasure. The hotel is a short walk from various Government agencies, Embassies, the diplomatic quarter and the International Exhibition Centre, and is in walking distance from an array of shopping options. Hanoi Hotel is 30 kilometers from Noi Bai International Airport and 3 kilometers from the Hanoi Railway Station. The hotel’s luxury accommodation features sweeping views of the lake, city and beyond. Elegantly furnished and equipped with a range of modern amenities, the rooms are sure to make your stay a pleasant and comfortable one. Hanoi Hotel also provides a wide range of facilities like restaurants, meeting rooms, serviced office, tennis court, sauna & massage, fitness center, e-gaming center and evening entertainment club. Our dedicated and well-trained staff is ready to show you why hospitality is one of our hallmarks. The Hanoi Hotel is renowned for its complete range of evening entertainment and the best Chinese cuisine in the city.
